crew.overview: During World War II, two French civilians and a downed British Bomber Crew set out from Paris to cross the demarcation line between Nazi-occupied Northern France and the South. From there they will be able to escape to England. First, they must avoid German troops – and the consequences of their own blunders.
crew.title: Don't Look Now... We're Being Shot At!

details.biography:
Alain Douarinou (1909–1987) was a French cinematographer. He was the younger brother of the art director Jean Douarinou, and was married to Madeleine Sologne.

details.name: Alain Douarinou
details.place_of_birth: Saigon, French Indochina [now Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam]
